name: patient_diarrhea_value_recorded_inthepast24hours_withunit_per_day
meaning: Numeric value representing the number of diarrheal stools per day the patient had in the 24 hours prior to randomization.
when_unknown: Set to null if the number of diarrheal stools per day in the 24 hours prior to randomization is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the measured or reported number of diarrheal stools per day the patient had in the 24 hours prior to randomization.

name: investigator_judges_c_difficile_is_likely_causative_agent_of_patient_diarrhea_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether, in the judgment of the investigator, Clostridioides difficile infection is the likely causative agent for the patient's current diarrhea.
when_true: Set to true if, in the judgment of the investigator, Clostridioides difficile infection is the likely causative agent for the patient's current diarrhea.
when_false: Set to false if, in the judgment of the investigator, Clostridioides difficile infection is not the likely causative agent for the patient's current diarrhea.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether, in the judgment of the investigator, Clostridioides difficile infection is the likely causative agent for the patient's current diarrhea.

name: patient_has_finding_of_clostridioides_difficile_infection_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has Clostridioides difficile infection.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has Clostridioides difficile infection.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have Clostridioides difficile infection.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has Clostridioides difficile infection.

name: patient_has_finding_of_clostridioides_difficile_infection_now@@primary_episode
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current Clostridioides difficile infection is a primary episode.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current Clostridioides difficile infection is a primary episode.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current Clostridioides difficile infection is not a primary episode.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the episode is primary.

name: patient_has_finding_of_clostridioides_difficile_infection_now@@first_recurrence
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's current Clostridioides difficile infection is a first recurrence.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's current Clostridioides difficile infection is a first recurrence.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's current Clostridioides difficile infection is not a first recurrence.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the episode is a first recurrence.

name: patient_has_finding_of_hospital_patient_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently classified as a hospital patient (inpatient or outpatient).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently classified as a hospital patient (either inpatient or outpatient).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently not classified as a hospital patient (neither inpatient nor outpatient).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently classified as a hospital patient.

name: patient_is_inpatient_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently an inpatient.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently admitted as an inpatient.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently admitted as an inpatient.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current inpatient status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_outpatient_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently an outpatient.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently an outpatient.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently an outpatient.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current outpatient status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
